# Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Mobile-first feature flags for .NET MAUI: remote configuration, device/OS/country/user targeting, percentage rollout, kill switches, and offline cache.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-feature-flags/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Current release

1.0.8. Adds Mac Catalyst and Windows TFMs. 1.0.7 (3 September 2026) required https for RemoteUri (RequireHttps = true). Optional SignatureKey verifies X-FeatureFlags-Signature as HMAC-SHA256 hex over the response body.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Registration: `UseMauiFeatureFlags` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I add feature flags in .NET MAUI?
- Remote config with percentage rollout on mobile
- Offline-cached kill switches

## Do not use when

- The org already uses LaunchDarkly, Azure App Configuration, or Firebase Remote Config as the standard
